diagnosis: Intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile duct
legend: Low-grade epithelium of intestinal type with basally located, slightly elongated nuclei and mild nuclear atypia without copious cytoplasmic mucin (formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissue; H&E).
